annotations.title: utilpeek: GPU price history to JSON or CSV by chip and region

description: utilpeek: Export GPU price history by chip and region. Returns recorded GPU offers as JSON/CSV, with available dates, missing days/providers and last update Input: optional chip, regions, provider, paired from/to, format, output. Default newest 30 days; up to 366 days, 20,000 rows, 8 MB; no invented dates. No matching rows is not charged. CSV formula-like text gets a leading quote. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 3. No free tier. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/cloud-gpu-price-api.html

chip.description: Exact chip, any case; omitted: all chips.
chip.title: Chip

format.description: Export file format; CSV coverage stays in the response.
format.title: Format

from.description: First UTC date; supply with to.
from.title: From

output.description: url (default): stored for 24 hours; link, metadata. base64: inline.
output.title: Output

regions.description: Exact regions, any case; Akash uses marketplace.
regions.title: Regions

to.description: Last UTC date; at most 366 days, 20,000 rows, 8 MB. Omit both: newest 30 days.
to.title: To

name: export_gpu_price_history

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
